input_components.schema_boundary: InputManager has no custom serialized bytes. PlayerInput supports the observed zero-count UnityEvents/action-events, then auto-switch bool, default strings, screen index and camera PPtr. RebindSaveManager has one asset PPtr and aligned string, consuming EOF.
input_components.runtime_boundary: These are shipped defaults. The configured InputActionOverrides.json path does not establish saved user overrides or effective runtime controls. No persistent user directory is inspected. InputManager/PlayerInput membership and execution-order values do not establish Awake order or singleton survival.

MCommon.schema_boundary: First24 instance fields only, supported by original declaration order, registered field types and interop properties. The Color occupies16B and scalar fields4B. This source has no embedded type tree; the remaining DynamicBoneData/configuration schema is not decoded.

MAction.schema_boundary: MAction actions PPtr vector consumes EOF. SexActionBias is a native static literal and dict is nonserialized in this interpretation. Each MActionRecord only decodes its first6 fields; boolean values align to4 and remaining bytes stay opaque.
MAction.runtime_boundary: Stored canMove is configuration, not the computed MActionRecord.CanMove property's full behavior. Native action/state conditions may override whether movement or cancellation actually occurs.

movement_configuration.runtime_boundary: These resources provide shipped parameters and action flags, not observed effective values. PlayerLocomotion is allocated at runtime; its constructor supplies gravity/jump parameters and native code combines state/configuration multipliers.

name_consistency.boundary: Only exact name correspondence is established here. Array position is not the InputType value; native InputManager table construction and input gating are analyzed separately.

player_prefab.limitation: Actual Player container key, root components and shipped type trees are structural evidence. limitations: Static evidence only; no game code execution or new REA session.
Bindings are shipped defaults, not observed effective controls. Saved rebinding overrides, device matching, processors and native input gating can change runtime behavior.
InputAction/InputType, action-type enums and player-state enums are distinct concepts; missing requested enum names are not invented.
Original metadata offsets, native field offsets and SerializedFile byte offsets use different coordinate systems and remain labeled.
Only selected prefab structures are decoded. Complete Animator/controller/animation event reconstruction and a runnable game are outside this inventory.
